tooltips.open: Opens a project from a .doodle file
tooltips.save: Saves the project to a .doodle file
tooltips.exportStl: Exports the scene to a binary STL file
tooltips.importStl: Imports a 3D model from an STL file
tooltips.copy: Copies selected objects to the clipboard
tooltips.fitView: Fits the view to the entire scene
tooltips.homeView: Resets the camera to its default position
tooltips.ruler: Distance measurement tool — 2 clicks to measure
tooltips.mirrorYz: Mirrors the object relative to the YZ plane
tooltips.mirrorXz: Mirrors the object relative to the XZ plane
tooltips.mirrorXy: Mirrors the object relative to the XY plane
tooltips.csgUnion: Combines the selected objects into one (union)
tooltips.csgSubtract: Subtract: select what to subtract from (A), press, then select what to subtract (B) and Enter — A − B as one CSG (subtract)
tooltips.csgIntersect: Intersect: select the first group (A), press, then select the second (B) and Enter — the common part of A and B as one CSG (intersect)
tooltips.themeToggle: Switches between dark and light theme
tooltips.clearScene: Removes all objects from the scene
tooltips.alignTool: Align mode: pick a plane (a face of object A or X / Y / Z), then click face B — it moves into plane A. With “Multiple” checked you can align several objects in a row. Esc or right click exits.
